name: s2s_v2d_multi_utterance
description: Vertical v2d happy path: three distinct audio-in utterances separated by gaps must yield exactly one commit/turn per utterance (18 recorded frames, 7 outbound client-to-server events).

steps.text: utterance one audio segment enters over the gap-bounded audio-in path
utterance two audio segment after an inter-utterance gap
utterance three audio segment after a second gap
